title: ReproduceRunRecord
description: A recorded benchmark run that the reproduce/tolerance gate re-runs and asserts against. The headline metric must reproduce within epsilon for bounded_nondeterministic arms, or EXACTLY for deterministic arms. Rounds are versioned (round_id + version).

bench.description: Dispatch key into the reproduce dispatch table (e.g. isota, mmlu, hellgraph).

round_id.description: Versioned round identifier; stamped onto every repro-ledger spine record.

determinism.description: deterministic -> exact match required; bounded_nondeterministic -> abs(observed-recorded) <= epsilon.

epsilon.description: Declared tolerance. REQUIRED (and > 0 in practice) for bounded_nondeterministic; ignored for deterministic (exact match).

headline_value.description: The recorded headline value the gate must reproduce.

seed_policy.description: How seeds are pinned for this run (e.g. MMLU_SEED=1729).

rerun.description: How the gate re-derives the observed headline. kind selects the in-process re-runner in the dispatch table.

external_command.description: Documentary: the one-command path a human runs to reproduce out-of-band (e.g. bash agent-machine/scripts/run-exam.sh). External arms are dispatched, not executed in-process by the gate.
